svg.title: Paloexiz
svg.desc: Paloexiz over blue and amber foliage sharing one continuous wind rhythm. Individual leaves sway around stationary stems. Twelve fur tufts, including both chin tufts, bend from fixed roots with delayed tips; the ears, muzzle and torso stay still. The offset background foliage mask and the separate inner shadow both follow the fur outline. Leaf colors are sampled before masks and shadows. Mr Dafoe signature and Cascadia Code copyright remain still.
